observations: Photo 0 shows a shop shelf heaped with many used car engine and gearbox mounts of different shapes and sizes: round rubber bushed mounts, bracket mounts and cylindrical hydraulic type mounts.
Photo 0: most metal parts are rusty and dirty; several have bolts still in place; some are tied with string or plastic ties.
Photo 0: one black cylindrical mount top right has a handwritten name on it in white marker; it is not a part number or a vehicle name.
Photo 0: no brand, part number or vehicle model can be read on any mount.
Photo 0 carries a 'POSTED ON JIJI' style watermark with a seller name across the middle, so this is a dealer's stock photo of mixed inventory.
The photo does not say which mount, or how many, is on sale, or which vehicle each one fits.
No close-up of any rubber element, so cracks, tears or leaks cannot be judged.

read_from: photo 0 shelf of used engine mounts, no part number readable

claims.claim: For engine seating and engine mounting (these are engine mounts)
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows used engine and gearbox mounts.

risks.risk: The advert covers mixed stock; the specific mount, its vehicle fitment and the quantity on sale are not stated.
risks.proof: A photo of the exact mount on offer with its part number or the vehicle it came from, beside a handwritten note with today's date.
risks.if_unproven: as one single used engine mount of unknown fitment

risks.risk: Rubber may be cracked, torn, perished or collapsed, or a hydraulic mount may have leaked, making it unusable.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rubber element from both sides of the mount on offer.
risks.if_unproven: as a worn mount at the bottom of the used range

risks.risk: Brackets are rusted and may have stretched or damaged bolt holes or threads.
risks.proof: Close-up of the bracket bolt holes and studs of the mount on offer.
risks.if_unproven: as a worn, rusty used mount

proof_requests: Photo of the exact mount on offer, with part number or source vehicle, and a handwritten note with today's date
State the vehicle it fits and how many pieces are sold
Close-up photos of the rubber element on both sides
Close-up of the bracket bolt holes and studs
response.reason: The photo clearly shows used car engine mounts, a plain part identifiable by type, so it can be priced at its worst case as one worn used engine mount of unknown fitment. Proof of the exact piece, its fitment and its rubber condition would raise it.
